key_highlights: ASX slides as oil hovers near US$100 amid Iran conflict, fuelling RBA rate-hike fears; big four banks fall
Iron ore weakness spreads globally, pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG valuations
RBA perceived to be 'choosing recession' as business conditions hit weakest since pandemic
Home buyer sentiment collapses to new milestone; NZ house crash echoes domestic concerns
Gold strength driven by geopolitical risk (Trump/Iran/China tensions); WA gold juniors active
Santos gas cartel scrutiny and NSW power shortfall raise energy transition risks
Qantas $35M redundancy payout and jet incident weigh on QAN.AX sentiment

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend; 'drowning not waving' signals sustained weakness. Gold counter-cyclical strength offsets partially. WA gold juniors (Forrestania, Gateway, Manhattan) active on M&A and drilling.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from soft iron ore. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NVL.AX, STO.AX) and uranium (INL.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as oil-driven rate-hike bets compress net interest margin expectations. Qantas $35M payout and jet incident add credit/operational noise. ATO vs Big Tech tax fight may affect revenue streams.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from rate uncertainty. Monitor NIM vs credit cost balance. QAN.AX faces operational and reputational headwinds.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran conflict benefits producers but raises input costs. Santos under scrutiny for gas cartel behaviour. NSW power shortfall and data centre demand strain grid. Energy transition questioned.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike but face regulatory risk. Energy transition names (SOL.AX, LNC.AX) face headwinds from data centre load. Monitor AEMO capacity warnings.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic. 102-year-old mall retailer closes 25 stores. Car supply crunch jacks up insurance. Home buyer sentiment collapses.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, IAG.AX face demand softness. REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) pressured by retail closures. Housing-linked names (MRG.AX, DHG.AX) under stress.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX and healthcare remain defensive havens. AI data centre buildout (Tasmania, NT) signals long-term tech demand but strains energy. Broadcom AI expansion positive for global tech.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive allocation. Tech exposure via global names (AVGO, DELL) but local energy constraints limit domestic data centre upside.

key_themes: Oil at US$100 driving inflation-recession trade-off for RBA
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 top-weight names
Geopolitical risk premium (Iran, Trump-China, Canada-US) elevating gold and safe havens
Domestic demand collapse: business conditions, housing sentiment, retail all at multi-year lows
Energy transition vs data centre demand creating grid stress in NSW and Tasmania
Santos gas cartel scrutiny reshaping domestic energy policy
AUD/USD likely under pressure from USD strength vs JPY and global risk-off

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil-driven inflation reigniting RBA rate hikes
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and growth exposure; favour fixed-income and dividend defensives

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse from China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and uranium
Trim consumer discretionary and housing-linked names; favour CSL.AX, WES.AX staples
Maintain 10-15% gold allocation; hedge with defensive equities

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW power shortfall and energy transition disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AEMO alerts; favour generators with firm capacity contracts
Review STOL.AX, SXR.AX exposure; monitor ACCC proceedings

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and uranium on geopolitical risk premium
opportunities.rationale: Oil at $100, Iran conflict, Trump-China tensions drive safe-haven demand; WA gold juniors active on M&A

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt into healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Recession fears and collapsing business/housing sentiment favour resilient cash-flow names

opportunities.recommendation: Selective oil/energy producer exposure on US$100 oil
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict sustains oil premium; but cap exposure given rate-hike risk to equities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and rate-sensitive REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; rate-hike bets compress REIT valuations and bank NIMs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim housing and consumer discretionary names
defensive_moves.rationale: Home buyer sentiment at new lows; NZ crash signals regional contagion; retail closures accelerating

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD downside; monitor QAN.AX operational risk
defensive_moves.rationale: USD strength vs JPY, global risk-off; Qantas jet incident and $35M payout weigh on sentiment

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to test lower supports as oil-driven rate-hike fears persist and iron ore weakness continues. Banks and materials lead declines. Gold and defensives outperform. Volatility elevated on Iran headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious: if RBA prioritises inflation over growth, recession risk rises. Iron ore structural shift reduces ASX 200 top-weight drag. Gold, healthcare, and energy transition names offer relative outperformance. Housing correction may extend 12+ months.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (recession vs inflation trade-off)
